> Epic 55 · Phase 2 · Depends on: 55.01, 55.02 · Needed by: 55.10

# Story 55.04 — Search: titles, transcripts, recent searches

> Epic 55 · Phase 2 · Depends on: 55.01, 55.02 · Needed by: 55.10

The desktop Player's search filters titles in the current library. The Android and Apple
Players search titles and words said in videos (Epic 49), suggest as the person types, keep
recent searches, and play a transcript hit at its moment. This story brings that search to the

# Story 55.07 — Live TV: Now, Guide, the channel player

> Epic 55 · Phase 2 · Depends on: 55.01, 55.02 · Needed by: 55.10

Live TV (Epic 27, story 48.30) is a section on the Android and Apple Players: what is on now on

entries.content:
# Story 55.08 — Watching: resume, tracks, subtitles, quality, Up Next, keys

> Epic 55 · Phase 2 · Depends on: 55.01, 55.02 · Needed by: 55.09, 55.10

## Why

The desktop player starts every video at 0, has no audio or subtitle choice, no quality, no Up
Next and few keys. The Android and Apple players (story 48.32) resume where the person left,
choose audio and subtitles (remembered), cap quality, offer the next episode, and the Mac

# Story 55.09 — Profile: history, favorites, playlists, sessions, settings

> Epic 55 · Phase 2 · Depends on: 55.01, 55.08 · Needed by: 55.10

## Why

The desktop Player has an Account menu (sign out, switch home, approve a sign-in) and a Language
menu. The Android and Apple Players have a Profile section: watch history with Forget,
favorites, playlists, sign-in sessions, approving a TV or device, playback settings, language,
and help and about. This story adds the Profile section; the menus stay as shortcuts.
